hooks.command: file=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$file" in */sidecar/build-script.ts) ;; */sidecar/*.test.ts) ;; */sidecar/*.ts) hits=$(grep -nE 'console\.log' "$file" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$hits" ]; then echo "⚠️  Sidecar stdout 只能输出最终 JSON，以下 console.log 会污染输出，请改用 console.error / logger（最终结果用 utils.ts 的 writeStdout）：" >&2; echo "$hits" >&2; fi ;; esac

file=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$file" in *.rs) command -v rustfmt >/dev/null 2>&1 && rustfmt --edition 2021 "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1 && cargo clippy --manifest-path "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/src-tauri/Cargo.toml" --quiet 2>&1 | tail -15 ;; esac
